turns.question: one csv is there. make a 2024 Monsoon block wise crop yield dashboard, tonnes per hectare highest first. i should see source and download the table
turns.sql: SELECT block, source, (harvest_tonnes * 1.0 / NULLIF(cultivated_hectares, 0)) AS tonnes_per_hectare FROM field_harvest WHERE year = 2024 AND season = 'Monsoon' ORDER BY tonnes_per_hectare DESC

turns.question: now show 2023 and 2024 Monsoon tonnes per hectare trend for every block
turns.sql: SELECT block, year, (harvest_tonnes * 1.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(cultivated_hectares, 0), 0)) AS tonnes_per_hectare FROM field_harvest WHERE year IN (2023, 2024) AND season = 'Monsoon' ORDER BY block NULLS FIRST, year NULLS FIRST

turns.question: only Bhojpur and Wardha now, compare change in tonnes per hectare from 2023 to 2024. keep source and download
turns.sql: SELECT fh1.block, fh1.year, fh1.source, (fh1.harvest_tonnes * 1.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(fh1.cultivated_hectares, 0), 0)) - (fh2.harvest_tonnes * 1.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(fh2.cultivated_hectares, 0), 0)) AS tonnes_per_hectare_change FROM field_harvest AS fh1 JOIN field_harvest AS fh2 ON fh1.block = fh2.block AND fh1.source = fh2.source AND fh1.season = fh2.season AND fh1.year = 2024 AND fh2.year = 2023 WHERE fh1.block IN ('Bhojpur', 'Wardha') AND fh1.season = 'Monsoon' ORDER BY fh1.block NULLS FIRST, fh1.year NULLS FIRST
